name: cache-tax
description: A Claude Code mod that keeps the one-hour prompt cache warm during breaks and asks before a cold send, showing its estimated rewrite cost. Warming uses model requests and costs tokens. Requires Claude Code 2.1.287+.

autoWarm.title: Auto keepwarm
autoWarm.description: on: after you pay a cold cache write, keepwarm arms itself for three hours (the default). off: keepwarm only runs when you arm it with /keepwarm.

pingFloor.title: Ping floor
pingFloor.description: A keepwarm ping goes out only when re-writing the context would cost at least this many times a ping. 2 by default; 0 never skips a ping.
